# GitHub Action Readme Generator - Coding Agent Instructions

All project details, coding guidelines, build/test/lint commands, and
process discipline for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)
at the repository root — the canonical, tool-agnostic source, kept
consistent across every agent harness. This file exists at this specific
path only because GitHub Copilot's coding agent looks for it here; Copilot
also natively supports `AGENTS.md` directly, so no content is duplicated
into this file.
